steps.title: VO2 Max
steps.body: The maximum volume of oxygen an individual can uptake, transport, and utilise per minute during maximal exercise.

steps.title: Inverted-U Theory
steps.body: Arousal theory stating performance increases with arousal up to an optimal midpoint, beyond which performance deteriorates.
